==Introduction==
Hi!  My name is Shawn Patrick Cooke.  I'm completely obtuse when it comes to formatting, but I have a great eye for detail when it comes to summarizing chapters and listing out every little thing that appears in them!  I am also a self-proclaimed encyclopedia of all things WoT; the kind of guy who can take fifteen minutes explaining the difference between Perival and Pelivar (two different Andoran nobles, you know).  It's about time I got some of that knowledge on paper so people could quit bugging me about it!

==Contribution Goals==
*My first goal is to try to add Chapter Summaries, at the rate of about one or two per day.  I'll try to use whichever is the most up-to-date format at the time, but forgive me if something goes screwy.
*My next goal will be to do pages on all the characters, especially the minor ones.  The easiest way to do that is simply to see which chapter summaries link to that character's name, compile all the information I can out of those, and write up the article.  I'm guessing that a good organization for a character would be:
**Description
**Chronology (i.e., what they've done)
**References (i.e., when people have talked about that character)
**Organizations to which they belong
**Links to theories involving that character, mayhaps?
